== Notes ==
*[[Damage reduction]], such as [[Protective Spirit]], will be taken into account after Primal Rage, therefore mitigating the double damage.
**If not using skills such as Protective Spirit, the use of a [[cancel stance]] is advisable.
* If playing PvE with a high rank in the [[Deldrimor]] title, consider bringing [[Drunken Master]] over Primal Rage since it provides a good [[IAS]] and [[IMS]] without any drawback. This is especially true if using [[alcohol]], as the two boosts will be respectively equal.

== Trivia ==
* [[w:Primal Rage|Primal Rage]] is the name of a 1994 video game.
